GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up home turn then shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early after being restrained to find cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a half length, Drifted Back a little middle stages, Hooked Out to 2 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Held Up rounding turn and blocked on straightening, shouldered into clear at 200m, ran on hitting Lead 40m from post. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages. Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead 3 Wide No Cover before eased back 2 Lengths @ 700m. Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed out 3 Wide @ 400m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & held ground in last 200m. # Worked early/sound
Slow Out 1 Lengths Quickly Recovered Went Forward Settled Down 2nd 3 Wide 1 Lengths in Two Wide x 600m Took over x 200m, run down x 100m, Sound Effort - faced # breeze, gave all
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened # slow recovery
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the mare, rider advised that his mount was agitated prior to the event, had raced flat, weakened in the straight and in his view had come to the end of its preparation. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to have a slow recovery rate. Racing Manager advised that the mare would now be sent for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led 4 lengths. turn. kept going in Straight # much too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out at the start and made contact with rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Went Forward led on rail x half length @ 800m. same to turn . kicked 1 length Clear Straightening Up . Kept Trying but Collared very late by $1.70 winner and $31 runner-up (had sat 2nd) # led until late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping was bumped on the hindquarter by another runner which shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: began well. Went Forward Slight Lead rail @ 800m. 1 length Clear home Turn . Ridden Along Same Straightening Up . Collared 250m, Gradually Gave Ground # led to the 250m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered when crowded on jumping between two other runners, both of which shifted.
